Web.name: American Trust Custody
Web.description: American Trust Custody is a large-scale enterprise platform delivering trust and custody services to financial intermediaries and institutions, including recordkeepers, retirement advisors, and financial institutions. The platform supports over 100,000 retirement plans and trust accounts with services spanning trust and custody, IRA solutions, paying agent and participant distribution, cash deposit alternatives, and collective investment trusts. Originally built on a legacy stack, the platform is being progressively modernized to React, Next.js, and TypeScript, and remains an active, ongoing engagement spanning 5 to 6 years.
features: Secure client login portal for financial intermediaries and institutions
Trust and custody management for retirement plans and trust accounts
401(k) model integration and ModelxChange model marketplace
IRA solution suite including auto rollover and abandoned plan handling
Cash deposit alternatives with multi-bank daily accrual options
Paying agent and participant distribution services for outsourced 1099 processing
Collective Investment Trust (CIT) sub-advisory support
Electronic order execution for mutual funds, equities, and fixed income
Role-based dashboards for recordkeepers, advisors, and financial institutions
Comprehensive reporting and compliance tools for large-scale retirement plans

lessons.text: Migrating a legacy module to React/Next.js incrementally, instead of a full rewrite, kept the platform stable for live financial users.
Combining Redux and React Query effectively requires clear boundaries between client state and server state.
Comprehensive Jest test coverage is essential for financial platforms where data accuracy and compliance are critical.
A well-structured Azure DevOps CI/CD pipeline significantly improves release confidence across a large, evolving codebase.

challenges.problem: Modernizing legacy modules to React and TypeScript without disrupting live financial workflows already in production.
challenges.solution: Adopted an incremental migration strategy, rebuilding and replacing modules feature-by-feature behind feature flags while the legacy and new stacks ran side by side.

challenges.problem: Managing both client-side and server-side state consistently while old and new architectures coexisted during migration.
challenges.solution: Standardized on React Query for server state and Redux/Context API for client state, establishing clear patterns adopted across both legacy and newly migrated modules.

challenges.problem: Ensuring reliability and compliance across financial workflows required rigorous testing as new modules were continuously shipped.
challenges.solution: Built an extensive Jest test suite integrated into Azure DevOps pipelines to catch regressions before each deployment.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Developed and continuously modernized enterprise-grade interfaces, migrating legacy screens to React, Next.js, and TypeScript while building reusable component libraries with Material UI and Tailwind CSS for trust, custody, and IRA modules.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Integrated React Query (TanStack) and Redux/Context API to manage server and client state across both newly migrated and legacy modules connecting to a .NET backend, supporting secure financial workflows for recordkeepers, advisors, and institutions.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Optimized rendering and data fetching for data-heavy financial dashboards handling large volumes of retirement plan and trust account data, while maintaining high test coverage with Jest within Azure DevOps pipelines.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: An ongoing modernization effort progressively migrating legacy screens to React, Next.js, and TypeScript, structured into modular feature domains for trust and custody, IRA solutions, and participant services, using Material UI and Tailwind CSS for a consistent, scalable design system.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Combined Redux and Context API for global client state with React Query (TanStack) for server state, caching, and synchronization, ensuring efficient data handling as new modules are migrated alongside the existing system.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: Connected to a .NET backend through secure, well-tested API layers, with Azure DevOps managing CI/CD pipelines and Jest ensuring reliability across deployments for this large-scale, actively evolving financial platform.

Web.name: PrixoSync
Web.description: PrixoSync (Prixomity) is a modern, responsive single-page application designed for complex data submissions, user management, and project detail tracking in the industrial and construction domain, covering products like Formawall Dimension Series, Industrial Foam, and IDME Next. The platform features a 13-step guided submission workflow covering account selection, project overview, weather and framing conditions, panel specifications, approvals, and final review. It supports role-based access, user and menu management, and offline-to-online data synchronization for field-data collection.
features: 13-step guided submission wizard with real-time progress tracking
Multi-domain data collection for Formawall, Industrial Foam, and IDME Next products
2D canvas drawing and visual manipulation using Konva for project diagrams
Voice-to-form speech input for field-worker accessibility
Offline-first submission caching with bulk sync to the server
Role management with dynamic permission and menu assignment
User management for adding, updating, and deleting accounts
PDF and document generation from submission data
Date-picking and weather/site condition tracking for visit logs
JWT-based authentication with automatic session handling on 401 errors

lessons.text: Splitting a long multi-step form into a dedicated wizard architecture made a 13-step submission process manageable for both users and developers.
Separating server state (React Query) from client state (Redux Toolkit) reduced boilerplate and simplified debugging significantly.
Building offline-first sync support early prevented major rework later for field-data collection use cases.
A centralized Axios interceptor for auth and error handling kept authentication logic consistent across every API call.

challenges.problem: Managing complex, multi-step submission forms with conditional steps and progress tracking across 13 phases.
challenges.solution: Built a dedicated stepper-based wizard architecture with isolated step components and centralized progress state.

challenges.problem: Supporting field workers who needed to submit data with unreliable or no internet connectivity.
challenges.solution: Implemented local caching of submissions with dedicated sync endpoints to push bulk data once connectivity was restored.

challenges.problem: Keeping UI components decoupled from network logic while handling authentication and error states consistently.
challenges.solution: Created a centralized API client with Axios interceptors to inject auth tokens and globally handle 401 errors and redirects.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Built the 13-step Create Submission wizard, role and user management dashboards, and dashboard widgets using React, TypeScript, and Bootstrap, with reusable components for forms, modals, and navigation.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Integrated React Query (TanStack) for server-state data fetching and Redux Toolkit for client-side state, connecting to a .NET backend through a centralized Axios-based API client with domain-specific service files.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Optimized data caching and background updates with React Query's stale-time configuration, and improved canvas rendering performance for Konva-based drawing features used in project diagrams.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: Built with React 18, TypeScript, and Vite, organized into feature-based domains (account, role management, submissions, user management) with nested routing and layout wrappers for authenticated and unauthenticated views.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Used a dual state management strategy: React Query handled asynchronous server data with built-in caching and retry logic, while Redux Toolkit managed synchronous global UI state like theme preferences and multi-step form data.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: Connected to a .NET Core backend through a centralized Axios API client with endpoint definitions organized by domain (Auth, Profile, Submission, Sync), supporting JWT-based authentication and bulk submission synchronization.

Web.name: React Martvill POS Addon
Web.description: This comprehensive POS and retail management solution helps businesses streamline sales, inventory, and customer management from a single platform. It offers fast checkout, secure transactions, smart inventory tracking, and flexible staff access controls to improve operational efficiency. The system supports discount management, order processing, and customer data management with an intuitive user-friendly interface. Designed for modern businesses, it is fully compatible with mobile and tablet devices for seamless access anywhere. With customizable features and real-time management capabilities, it provides a complete solution for retail operations.
features: User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive and easy-to-use interface designed for quick adoption by staff, reducing training time.
All-in-One Solution: Manages inventory, sales, and customer data in one platform.
Fast Product Order: Speedy checkout for better customer service.
Smart Retail Solution: Intelligent sales and inventory tracking.
Safe Transaction: Encrypted payments for security.
Discount and Coupon Management: Track and apply discounts easily.
Tablet and Mobile Compatibility: Works on mobile and tablet devices.
Staff Access Control: Manage staff permissions.
Order Management: Filter and manage orders easily.
Customer Management: Add/edit customers and shipping addresses.

lessons.text: Plan component structure early. Spending extra time on architecture upfront saved weeks of refactoring down the line.
Accessibility matters from day one. Retrofitting ARIA roles and keyboard navigation after the fact is far more expensive than building it in.
Design systems pay dividends. Building reusable tokens and components early made every feature sprint faster and more consistent.
Test in real browsers. Emulators and automated tests don't catch everything — real device testing revealed UI bugs that would have reached production.

challenges.problem: Complex state management across deeply nested component trees caused prop-drilling issues and unexpected re-renders.
challenges.solution: Introduced Redux Toolkit with selectors to centralize data flow and memoize expensive computations efficiently.

challenges.problem: Performance degraded on large datasets with hundreds of items rendered simultaneously in the product list views.
challenges.solution: Implemented virtualized list rendering and pagination to limit visible DOM nodes and keep scroll buttery-smooth.

challenges.problem: Consistent cross-browser UI inconsistencies, especially in older Firefox and Edge versions.
challenges.solution: Adopted a CSS reset layer, tested on BrowserStack, and added targeted browser-specific polyfills where needed.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Led the complete frontend implementation of React Martvill POS Addon from scratch — component design, layout system, and pixel-perfect conversion from Figma mockups.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Integrated all backend APIs for authentication, data fetching, and CRUD operations. Wrote reusable API hooks consumed across the entire application.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Profiled the app using React DevTools and Chrome Lighthouse. Reduced initial load time by 40% through code splitting and lazy loading.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: Built with React, organized into feature-based modules. Each feature owns its own components, hooks, and styles for clean separation of concerns.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Global state handled via Redux with a normalized store shape. Server state cached using custom hooks for efficient API reuse without redundant calls.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: RESTful API consumption through a centralized Axios instance with request interceptors for auth headers, error handling, and loading state automation.

Web.name: Study Manager
Web.description: Study Manager is an AI-driven SaaS platform built as a complete operating system for education consultants, helping them manage student applications, university matching, and communication at scale. It offers an AI-powered Best Fit engine for matching students to universities, an omnichannel communication hub, and automated document processing. The platform supports multi-tier access control across super admin, branch, partner, agent, and employee roles, along with separate consultant and student dashboards and a post-arrival marketplace for settled students.
features: AI 'Best Fit' engine for matching students to universities based on eligibility
Omnichannel hub centralizing WhatsApp, Email, and internal chat communication
Automated document verification and application status processing
Integrated lead generation feeding directly into the consultant dashboard
White-label branding for a fully customized consultancy experience
Post-arrival marketplace for student housing, jobs, and essentials
Multi-tier access control for super admin, branch, partner, agent, and employees
Separate consultant and student dashboards for tailored workflows
Employee KPI tracking and income/expense reporting for branches
Sub-agent management, referral tracking, and commission visibility for partners

lessons.text: Designing for multiple user roles (admin, branch, partner, agent, employee) early simplifies permission-based UI rendering later.
Keeping consultant and student dashboards visually consistent while serving different workflows improves overall usability.
Centralizing communication channels into one hub significantly reduces UI complexity for end users.
White-label theming requires careful component design so branding changes don't break layout consistency.

challenges.problem: Supporting five distinct user roles with different dashboard views and permissions increased UI complexity.
challenges.solution: Built role-based Redux state and route guards to dynamically render the correct dashboard and permissions per role.

challenges.problem: Synchronizing student status across consultant, agent, and student dashboards caused data inconsistency.
challenges.solution: Centralized student profile and status data in Redux so all dashboards reflected real-time updates consistently.

challenges.problem: Managing omnichannel messages (WhatsApp, Email, internal chat) in a single interface created UI performance issues.
challenges.solution: Implemented a unified, paginated message hub component with optimized rendering for high message volumes.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Built responsive React interfaces for both the consultant dashboard and the student dashboard, covering lead management, application tracking, communication hub, and multi-tier admin views with Bootstrap-based styling.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Integrated the .NET backend APIs for student data, application status, document handling, and the omnichannel communication system, connecting WhatsApp, Email, and chat into a unified interface.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Optimized Redux state updates and component rendering across dashboards with large student and lead datasets, improving responsiveness for high-volume consultant accounts.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: Built with React and Bootstrap, structured into separate consultant and student dashboard modules with shared reusable components for tables, forms, and communication panels.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Managed application state with Redux, handling role-based permissions, student status tracking, and real-time synchronization between consultant, agent, and student views.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: Connected to a .NET backend through RESTful APIs, handling authentication, multi-tier role authorization, document processing, and communication channel integration consistently across dashboards.

Web.name: Martvill
Web.description: MartVill is an optimized, multi-vendor e-commerce platform. It features advanced multi-location inventory management and a dynamic homepage builder. The system includes a full delivery man management module with earnings and withdrawal tracking. It provides advanced reporting, multi-language support, and secure OTP verification systems. Integrated with UddoktaPay, it delivers a fast, scalable solution for modern online marketplaces.
features: Advanced Inventory: Supports multiple shops, warehouse locations, product transfers, and detailed logs.
Homepage Builder: Built-in tool to design multiple custom homepages without coding.
Delivery Man Module: Admin and vendors can assign orders, track online status, and manage payouts.
Laravel 12 & MySQL 9: Upgraded core framework and database for maximum speed and security.
Advanced Reports: Detailed customer ledger, supplier ledger, and sales analysis modules.
Multi-Language & RTL: Multilingual product/category setup with RTL image flipping for global reach.
Robust Security: XSS vulnerability fixes, reCAPTCHA protection, and vendor OTP verification.
Dynamic Invoicing: Automated PDF invoice generation and a fullscreen email template editor.
Smart Product Search: Enhanced Select2 search filters and optimized pricing/sorting logic.
Vendor Management: Revamped permission controls, profile updates, and automatic default locations.
POS & Purchase Orders: Streamlined Point of Sale (POS) addon and supplier purchase order printing.
UddoktaPay & Buy Now: Instant checkout using the 'Buy Now' feature and UddoktaPay gateway.

lessons.text: Standardize UI Components Early since unifying elements like form buttons into a single reusable component vastly improves frontend visual consistency and speeds up future UI development

Decouple Core Logic from Layouts because implementing a dedicated homepage builder demonstrates that giving users the power to customize layouts without altering core backend code reduces maintenance overhead and bugs

Plan for Global Accessibility as building native support for multi-language sidebar switchers, country-based phone filters, and RTL image flipping highlights the importance of designing a flexible layout that naturally scales for international users

challenges.problem: Slow Homepage and Product Page Loading Times
challenges.solution: Optimized the initial installation page, homepage, and product search while implementing advanced Laravel cache management to significantly boost frontend loading speeds.

challenges.problem: Poor Mobile UI/UX and Navigation Constraints
challenges.solution: Redesigned the login form and category UI for a modern look, and added a dedicated Compare option and Language switcher directly into the mobile view sidebar.

challenges.problem: Inaccurate Product Searching and Variable Stock Display
challenges.solution: Fixed frontend price sorting/pricing issues, added a color picker, and optimized the system so variable product stocks display accurately in real-time as supported by image_df6259.png

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Led full-scale marketplace UI development by standardizing form components for visual consistency and spearheading layout builders to enable dynamic web pages.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Managed asynchronous data flows using optimized search filters and coordinated frontend form synchronization with backend ledgers for smooth workflows.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Directed asset optimization to drastically accelerate homepage loading speeds and resolved client-side vulnerabilities within the product search interface.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: Utilizes a custom, built-in Homepage Builder to generate multiple layouts on the fly without changing backend code.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: ession & Local Browser State: Client-side tracking—such as the Cart Identifier, user authentication states, and multi-language selections—is maintained via secure browser cookies, session storage, and local storage.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: API Gateway Integration: Seamlessly integrates with third-party REST APIs for real-time services, including UddoktaPay for secure payment processing and external SMS gateways for the OTP Logging System.

Web.name: Artifism
Web.description: Artifism is a comprehensive AI-powered SaaS platform built with Laravel (Backend) and React, TypeScript, Redux, and Tailwind CSS (Frontend)**. The platform provides content, image, video, voiceover, and chatbot generation through multiple AI providers, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and DeepSeek. I contributed to the frontend development by building responsive and scalable user interfaces using React and Tailwind CSS, implementing efficient state management with Redux, and developing AI chatbot functionalities with real-time interactions. The system features subscription management, credit-based usage tracking, multi-provider AI integration, and an AI Social Suite for social media management. It supports a wide range of AI-powered services, including text generation, code assistance, image and video creation, voice cloning, and AI avatar generation.
features: Multi-model AI content, code, and long-article generation (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek)
AI image generation with multiple providers (DALL-E, Flux, Nano Banana, Stable Diffusion)
Text-to-Video and Image-to-Video generation (Sora, Veo, Kling, Seedance)
AI Chatbot builder with document, web, and vision chat support
Voiceover and voice cloning powered by ElevenLabs and Gemini
AI Social Suite for Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok management
AI Detector and Plagiarism checker with exportable PDF reports
Subscription and credit-based billing with multiple payment gateways
Marketing Bot with Telegram and WhatsApp automation
Affiliate, coupon, and team member management system

lessons.text: Building an abstraction layer early saves significant time when integrating multiple similar AI provider services.
Performance optimization should be planned from the start, not added as an afterthought once galleries grow large.
Modular, reusable components make scaling features across a large multi-feature platform much easier.
Keeping UI components decoupled from provider-specific logic made adapting to frequent AI model updates painless.

challenges.problem: Managing inconsistent API response formats from multiple AI providers caused integration complexity.
challenges.solution: Built a unified abstraction layer to normalize responses from different AI providers into a single format.

challenges.problem: Large image and video galleries caused slow load times and laggy scrolling.
challenges.solution: Implemented lazy loading and pagination to significantly improve gallery performance.

challenges.problem: Maintaining UI consistency while supporting frequent provider and model updates.
challenges.solution: Created reusable, modular UI components that adapt automatically to new providers and models.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Designed and developed responsive user interface components across the admin, customer, and landing panels, ensuring consistent styling, intuitive navigation, and dark/light mode support throughout the platform.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Connected multiple third-party AI provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, FAL AI, ElevenLabs) into a unified interface, enabling seamless switching between models for content, image, video, and voice generation features.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Optimized data loading and rendering for image galleries, dashboards, and data tables, improving load times and reducing unnecessary re-renders across high-traffic sections of the application.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: The frontend was built using a component-based structure with reusable UI elements for dashboards, galleries, chat interfaces, and settings panels. Dark and light mode theming was implemented consistently across all panels, while responsive layouts ensured usability across desktop and mobile devices.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Application state was organized to handle real-time updates for credits, subscription status, and generation progress across multiple AI features. Centralized state handling allowed smooth synchronization between user actions, API responses, and UI updates without unnecessary reloads.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: The backend layer connected to multiple AI provider APIs through a unified service interface, allowing the platform to route requests dynamically based on user-selected models. This integration handled authentication, credit deduction, request formatting, and error handling for each provider consistently.

Web.name: PayMoney
Web.description: PayMoney is a secure online payment gateway platform that enables smooth and reliable financial transactions, similar to services like PayPal or Stripe. It supports deposits and payouts through multiple payment gateways including PayPal, Stripe, Payeer, and Coinbase, along with currency exchange and crypto send/receive features. The system includes merchant tools, dispute resolution, KYC verification, and a multilevel referral system. Built on Laravel, it offers a complete financial ecosystem with extensive paid add-ons for tokens, remittance, and virtual cards.
features: Deposit, withdrawal, and transfer of funds across multiple wallets and currencies
Currency exchange between user wallets with local or API-based rates
Support for 7+ payment methods including PayPal, Stripe, Payeer, and Coinbase
Crypto send/receive for Bitcoin, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Ethereum, and Tron
TRC-20 token deployment and token send/receive on the Tron network
Merchant system with Standard and Express checkout payment forms
Dispute management system for resolving merchant-related claims
Integrated support ticketing system for customer issue handling
KYC verification with address and identity document approval workflow
Two-factor authentication via email, phone, and Google Authenticator

lessons.text: Handling financial transactions requires strict validation and error handling at every step.
Integrating multiple payment gateways early helped establish a consistent abstraction pattern for future providers.
Security features like 2FA and KYC need clear, guided UI flows to avoid user confusion.
Well-structured datatables and filters significantly improve admin efficiency for transaction-heavy systems.

challenges.problem: Coordinating multiple payment gateways and crypto providers with different APIs and response formats.
challenges.solution: Built a centralized payment processor layer to standardize gateway integrations and responses.

challenges.problem: Displaying and filtering large transaction datasets caused performance issues in the admin panel.
challenges.solution: Implemented optimized datatables with server-side filtering, pagination, and CSV/PDF export.

challenges.problem: Ensuring secure account access while keeping the verification process user-friendly.
challenges.solution: Designed a streamlined 2FA and KYC flow with clear step-by-step UI guidance and status indicators.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Developed responsive interfaces for the admin and user panels covering wallets, transactions, merchants, disputes, and KYC verification, maintaining consistent design and dark mode support.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Integrated multiple payment gateways (PayPal, Stripe, Payeer, CoinPayments, Coinbase) and crypto providers into a unified transaction flow for deposits, transfers, and exchanges.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Optimized transaction datatables and reporting views to handle large volumes of records with fast filtering, sorting, and export capabilities.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: Built with reusable component structures covering wallets, transaction history, merchant tools, and dispute management, with consistent theming and responsive layouts across admin and user panels.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Managed real-time updates for wallet balances, transaction statuses, and exchange rates, ensuring the UI reflects accurate financial data immediately after any user action.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: Connected to multiple payment gateway and blockchain APIs through a unified processor layer, handling authentication, currency conversion, fee calculation, and transaction logging consistently across providers.

Web.name: Pay Money Cryptoexchange
Web.description: CryptExchange is a crypto swap and buy/sell addon for the PayMoney payment gateway, enabling users to exchange cryptocurrencies quickly and securely. Administrators can configure unlimited exchange directions for buying, selling, and swapping coins. The platform supports both registered and unregistered users, allowing exchanges through wallets, external addresses, and multiple payment gateways. Users can track their transaction history at any time, with admin tools for managing rates, directions, and reports.
features: Crypto-to-crypto swap with admin-configurable exchange directions
Buy and sell cryptocurrency using multiple payment gateways
Exchange access for both registered and unregistered users
Support for external wallet addresses for receiving crypto
Real-time transaction tracking for exchangers from any location
Flutterwave, CoinPayments, and Coinbase gateway integration for crypto purchases
Admin panel for managing exchange rates and directions (Local/API)
CSV and PDF report generation for transaction history
Automated email and SMS notifications for transaction updates
RTL support and responsive UI for the user panel

lessons.text: Exchange rate accuracy depends heavily on reliable API integration and fallback handling for local rates.
Supporting guest users in financial flows requires extra care around address validation and transaction tracking.
Clear PDF and CSV exports are essential for users and admins to audit crypto transactions.
Keeping an addon compatible with frequent core platform updates requires modular, version-aware code.

challenges.problem: Exchange directions sometimes became unavailable or wallet balances went negative due to rate calculation issues.
challenges.solution: Refined the exchange rate calculation and validation logic to correctly handle both API and local rate modes.

challenges.problem: Supporting unregistered users in crypto swap and sell transactions caused missing receiving address data in the admin panel.
challenges.solution: Updated the transaction flow to properly capture and display guest user receiving addresses in admin records.

challenges.problem: Maintaining compatibility with the core PayMoney platform across frequent version updates.
challenges.solution: Refactored migrations, seeders, and UI components to align with the latest PayMoney releases and mega menu structure.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Built the crypto swap, buy, and sell interfaces for the user panel, along with admin screens for managing exchange directions, rates, and transaction reports.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Integrated Flutterwave, CoinPayments, and Coinbase payment gateways for crypto purchases, and connected exchange rate APIs for accurate swap pricing.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Optimized transaction listing and report generation, improving CSV/PDF export speed and overall asset loading for the exchange module.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: Developed responsive swap, buy, and sell forms with RTL support, plus admin interfaces for configuring exchange directions and viewing transaction history.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Managed real-time exchange rate updates, wallet balance checks, and transaction status changes to keep swap and buy/sell flows accurate and synchronized.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: Connected to crypto exchange rate APIs and multiple payment gateways within the PayMoney core, handling rate conversion, balance validation, and transaction logging for each exchange type.

Web.name: Amader Service
Web.description: Amader Service is a leading home and commercial service marketplace platform in Bangladesh, connecting customers with verified service providers for tasks like cleaning, repairs, AC servicing, and other household needs. The platform offers an easy booking system where users can browse service categories, select providers, and schedule appointments. It includes both customer and service provider panels, with admin tools for managing bookings, service categories, and providers across major cities.
features: Browse and book home services across multiple categories
Service provider listings with ratings and details
Scheduled booking with date and time selection
Customer dashboard for managing bookings and order history
Service provider panel for managing job requests and availability
Admin panel for managing categories, providers, and bookings
Location-based service availability across major cities
Secure online and offline payment options
Responsive design for mobile and desktop users
Customer support and service request tracking

lessons.text: Location-based service availability requires careful handling of multi-city data and provider coverage.
A clear booking flow improves conversion for customers unfamiliar with online service marketplaces.
Separate, role-specific dashboards for customers and service providers reduce confusion and improve usability.
Centralized Redux state for bookings and provider availability kept the UI consistent across multiple panels.

challenges.problem: Displaying accurate service availability across different cities and categories caused inconsistent listings.
challenges.solution: Restructured the Redux store to centralize service and location data, ensuring consistent filtering by city and category.

challenges.problem: Booking flow felt complex for first-time users, leading to drop-offs before confirmation.
challenges.solution: Simplified the booking steps with a clearer category-to-confirmation flow and progress indicators using React components.

challenges.problem: Managing provider availability and booking conflicts in the admin panel was difficult at scale.
challenges.solution: Built a centralized booking management view with Redux-driven state updates for admins to track and resolve scheduling conflicts.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Developed responsive React components for the customer-facing booking flow, service provider dashboard, and admin panel, ensuring consistent design across categories and locations.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Integrated booking, payment, and location-based service filtering features into a unified customer experience using Redux for state management across the platform.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Optimized service listing pages and booking forms with efficient Redux selectors and component re-render management for faster load times on mobile devices.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: Built with React, organized into reusable components for service listings, booking forms, and dashboards, with a mobile-first responsive design suited for users across Bangladesh.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Managed booking status, provider availability, and category filters through a centralized Redux store, keeping the customer and provider views synchronized in real time.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: Connected to backend services handling bookings, payments, and provider management through API calls dispatched via Redux actions, ensuring accurate data flow between customer requests and provider responses.

Web.name: vRent
Web.description: vRent is an online vacation rental marketplace designed for landlords to list holiday rentals and for guests to find and book accommodations worldwide. The platform supports unlimited property listings with advanced calendar-based pricing, search and filter options, and multiple payment gateways including PayPal, Stripe, and Razorpay. It features a wallet system, host service fees, review and rating, and a built-in messaging system between guests and hosts. Admins can manage property approvals, reports, and translations, with full support for Google Maps and iCalendar integration.
features: Unlimited property listings with full add, edit, and manage capabilities
Advanced calendar module for date-based pricing and availability blocking
Multiple payment gateways including PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, and Flutterwave
Google Maps integration with property location search
Advanced search and filter by city, state, country, dates, and price range
Wallet system with host balance and withdrawal requests
Message communication system between guests and hosts
Review and rating system for hosts and properties
iCalendar integration for import, export, and calendar sync
Sub-admin management with role-based permissions

lessons.text: Calendar-based pricing logic needs careful date handling to avoid conflicts across months and time zones.
Supporting multiple currencies and payment gateways early made it easier to expand to new regions later.
RTL layout support should be planned into the component structure from the start, not retrofitted.
A clear messaging and notification system greatly improves trust between guests and hosts.

challenges.problem: Review submissions occasionally created duplicate entries due to multiple click events.
challenges.solution: Added click-debouncing and backend validation to prevent duplicate review submissions.

challenges.problem: The booking calendar took time to load properly when the database contained large amounts of data.
challenges.solution: Optimized calendar queries and implemented caching to speed up date availability rendering.

challenges.problem: Implementing RTL layout for Arabic without breaking the existing LTR design across all pages.
challenges.solution: Restructured CSS using logical properties and direction-aware components to support both layouts cleanly.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Built responsive interfaces for property listings, booking flows, search/filter pages, and host/guest dashboards, including RTL layout support for Arabic.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Integrated multiple payment gateways (PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, PayTR, Yookassa), Google Maps, and social login providers into the booking and authentication flows.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Optimized database queries and calendar rendering for properties with extensive date and pricing data, improving page load times across search and booking pages.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: Built with reusable components for property listings, booking calendars, search filters, and messaging, supporting both LTR and RTL layouts with consistent responsive design.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Managed booking status, wallet balances, and calendar availability in real time, ensuring guests and hosts see consistent property and transaction data across the platform.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: Connected to multiple payment gateways, Google Maps API, and social login providers through a unified addon manager, handling booking verification, commission calculation, and notification dispatch.

Web.name: RoverCRM
Web.description: RoverCRM is an all-in-one CRM, inventory, and project management system with a built-in POS module. It allows businesses to manage customers, suppliers, sales, purchases, stock, invoices, and payments from a single platform. The system supports multi-warehouse inventory tracking, project and task management with time tracking, and a support ticket system. With graphical dashboards, detailed reports, and multilingual RTL/LTR support, it offers a complete business management solution.
features: Graphical dashboard with invoices, quotations, expenses, and leads overview
Relationship management for customers, suppliers, and team members
Professional invoice and quotation generation with taxes and discounts
Purchase order management with automatic inventory updates
POS module with multi-bill handling and real-time stock tracking
Stock management with multi-warehouse support and stock transfers
Project and task management with milestones, files, and task timer
Support ticket system with knowledge base and canned responses
Bank account management with deposits, transfers, and reconciliation
Multilingual support with RTL/LTR layout switching

lessons.text: Real-time stock updates across POS, purchases, and sales require tightly synchronized data flow.
Dashboard charts with multiple data sources benefit from a consistent, reusable charting structure.
Multilingual and RTL/LTR support is easier to maintain when built into the component design from the start.
Clear permission-based UI rendering simplifies managing multiple user roles like admin, customer, and POS.

challenges.problem: POS design and functionality had issues affecting multi-bill handling and product search.
challenges.solution: Redesigned and fixed the POS interface for smoother multi-bill management and faster product lookup.

challenges.problem: Report generation and transaction date filters produced incorrect or inconsistent results.
challenges.solution: Fixed date handling logic across sales, purchase, income, and expense reports for accurate filtering.

challenges.problem: Team member and ticket design inconsistencies affected usability across the admin panel.
challenges.solution: Refactored team member and ticket UI components for a consistent, improved design.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Developed responsive interfaces for the dashboard, POS, project management, invoicing, and customer panels, including multilingual and RTL/LTR layout support.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Integrated payment options including PayPal and bank accounts for invoices and purchase orders, along with currency conversion API for multi-currency support.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Improved stock level synchronization across POS, sales, and purchases, and optimized report generation for large transaction datasets.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: Built with reusable components for dashboards, POS screens, invoices, project boards, and ticket interfaces, supporting dark theme and multilingual RTL/LTR layouts.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Managed real-time inventory levels, task statuses, and financial data across POS, projects, and banking modules, ensuring consistent updates throughout the system.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: Connected to payment gateways and currency conversion APIs through a unified service layer, handling invoice payments, stock adjustments, and email/SMS notifications consistently.

Web.name: PayMoney - Mobile App
Web.description: PayMoney Mobile App is the Android companion application for the PayMoney secure online payment gateway, allowing users to send and request money quickly between friends and family. It supports currency exchange, payouts via bank or PayPal, and crypto deposits through CoinPayments. Users can manage their wallets, view transaction history, and update their profile directly from the app. With QR code support, users can also send, request, and pay by scanning codes.
features: Send money instantly to friends and family with no extra transaction fee
Request money from other users, with accept or decline options
Currency exchange with real-time conversion rate details
Payouts to bank or PayPal with instant wallet cash-out
User dashboard showing all active wallets and balances
Detailed user activity log for deposits, transfers, and merchant payments
QR code support for sending, requesting, and making payments
Crypto deposit and withdrawal via CoinPayments integration
Login via phone number with international telephone input
Profile management with picture and payout settings updates

lessons.text: Mobile wallet apps need strict decimal precision handling, especially when supporting crypto values up to 8 decimals.
Token-based API authentication is essential for securing sensitive financial actions from a mobile client.
QR code features simplify peer-to-peer transactions and reduce input errors for sending and requesting money.
Real-time notifications for deposits, payouts, and transfers improve user trust in financial apps.

challenges.problem: Currency exchange produced incorrect results when the target currency rate was set to API mode.
challenges.solution: Fixed the exchange calculation logic to correctly handle API-based currency conversion rates.

challenges.problem: Send money confirmation pages sometimes displayed incorrect amounts and totals.
challenges.solution: Corrected the amount and total calculation logic on the send money confirmation screen.

challenges.problem: Unauthorized users could access certain app screens without proper redirection.
challenges.solution: Implemented automatic redirection to the login page for unauthorized API responses.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Developed mobile UI screens for send money, request money, wallet dashboard, transaction history, and user profile using jQuery Mobile and Cordova.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Integrated PayPal, Stripe, bank payout, and CoinPayments crypto deposit/withdrawal with the core PayMoney API, along with QR code scanning for payments.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Secured API calls with authorization tokens and optimized transaction list rendering with dynamic decimal formatting and date display.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: Built as a Cordova-based hybrid mobile app with jQuery Mobile UI components for wallets, transactions, send/request money, and profile management screens.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Managed wallet balances, default wallet selection, and transaction states across send, request, exchange, and payout actions, keeping the dashboard in sync after each action.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: Connected to the PayMoney core API using token-based authentication, handling payment gateway calls, crypto deposits via CoinPayments, and dynamic notifications for all transaction types.

App.name: Martvill - Customer Mobile App
App.description: Martvill Customer Mobile App is a feature-rich cross-platform mobile application built with React Native and Expo, exclusively designed as the mobile companion for the Martvill global multivendor ecommerce platform. It provides customers with a seamless shopping experience including product browsing, cart management, secure checkout, order tracking, and refund requests from Android and iOS devices. The app supports B2B interactions, RTL layout for multilingual users, and integrates with the Martvill backend for real-time account and order synchronization.
features: Customer profile management with account creation, login, and preference settings
Intuitive product search with smart filters and category browsing
Detailed product pages with high-quality images, descriptions, and reviews
Cart management and secure checkout with multiple payment options
Real-time order tracking with shipment update notifications
Refund request creation and refund history tracking
Wishlist for saving and revisiting desired products
B2B module for business-to-business interactions
RTL support for multilingual and right-to-left language users
SSO login support and reCAPTCHA integration for secure authentication

lessons.text: Upgrading React Native and Expo regularly is essential to maintain performance and compatibility across Android and iOS versions.
RTL support requires careful layout planning from the start, as retrofitting it later causes widespread component changes.
Optimizing bottom sheet and navigation flow significantly improves the perceived performance of a shopping app.
Guest user flows need as much attention as authenticated flows, since they cover a large portion of real-world app traffic.

challenges.problem: SSO login and guest order flows had recurring bugs across platform updates.
challenges.solution: Refactored the authentication and guest session handling logic and tested thoroughly across Android and iOS builds.

challenges.problem: Adding dynamic input fields for new address entry required flexible and reusable form architecture.
challenges.solution: Implemented dynamically generated input field components driven by backend configuration to support flexible address forms.

challenges.problem: Performance and loading issues appeared after package upgrades during major version bumps.
challenges.solution: Upgraded React Native and Expo to the latest stable versions and removed unnecessary files and legacy dependencies.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Built cross-platform mobile screens for product browsing, cart, checkout, order tracking, wishlist, refund requests, and profile management using React Native and Expo for both Android and iOS.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Integrated the Martvill backend APIs for authentication (including SSO and reCAPTCHA), product data, order management, refunds, and payment processing within a unified mobile interface.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Optimized bottom sheet behavior, navigation flow, and variant selection experience, and improved overall app reliability through regular Expo and React Native version upgrades.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: Built with React Native and Expo, organized into feature-based screens for shopping, account management, and order tracking, with RTL layout support and responsive design for both Android and iOS platforms.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Managed cart state, wishlist, order status, and user session data to keep the shopping experience consistent across screen transitions and background updates.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: Connected to the Martvill REST API for product listings, order processing, payment gateway calls, and user account management, with secure token-based authentication and reCAPTCHA support.

App.name: Artifism - AI Mobile App
App.description: Artifism Mobile App is a cross-platform AI-powered content creation app built with React Native, designed as the mobile companion to the Artifism SaaS platform. It enables users to generate text, images, code, voiceovers, and speech-to-text transcriptions directly from Android and iOS devices. The app supports multiple AI providers including OpenAI, DeepSeek, Stability AI, and Clipdrop, and features a modern dark mode UI, image gallery, bookmarks, and a credit-based subscription system.
features: AI text and content generation using GPT, DeepSeek, and other providers
AI image generation with Stability AI, DALL-E, and Clipdrop providers
AI code generation with multi-provider support including DeepSeek
Voiceover generation converting text to downloadable audio files
Speech-to-text transcription with PDF, DOCX, and clipboard export
Multiple AI chat assistants with use-case categories and favorites
Image and content history with bookmark and gallery management
Dark mode and modern UI with full-screen image browsing
Unified credit pricing system for subscription management
Cross-platform support for Android and iOS with regular version updates

lessons.text: Keeping the mobile app in sync with frequent SaaS backend updates requires modular, version-aware API integration.
Regular React Native and dependency upgrades are essential to maintain performance and cross-platform stability.
Supporting multiple AI providers in mobile requires a unified generation interface to avoid duplicating logic per provider.
Dark mode and modern UI enhancements significantly improve user engagement and retention in creative mobile apps.

challenges.problem: Multiple AI image and content providers returned inconsistent response formats, causing rendering issues.
challenges.solution: Refactored the generation logic into a unified abstraction layer to normalize outputs across all providers.

challenges.problem: Performance degraded after major React Native version upgrades due to incompatible legacy dependencies.
challenges.solution: Upgraded React Native to the latest stable version and updated all dependencies to their compatible versions.

challenges.problem: Adding voiceover and speech-to-text features required new file-handling and export flows not in the original architecture.
challenges.solution: Extended the existing generation module with dedicated audio file handling, supporting PDF, DOCX, and clipboard export options.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Built and continuously maintained mobile screens for content generation, image gallery, chat assistants, voiceover, speech-to-text, and subscription management, including dark mode and modern UI redesigns across Android and iOS.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Integrated multiple AI provider APIs (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Stability AI, Clipdrop) for text, image, code, voiceover, and speech-to-text generation, connecting to the Artifism SaaS backend through a unified API layer.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Optimized image generation performance, reduced generation response times, and improved overall app stability through regular React Native upgrades and dependency management.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: Built with React Native for cross-platform Android and iOS support, structured into feature modules for content, image, code, voiceover, and chat generation, with a consistent dark and light mode design system.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Managed generation history, bookmarks, subscription credits, and active session data to keep the user experience consistent across all generation features and screen transitions.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: Connected to the Artifism Laravel backend through a centralized API client, routing generation requests to the appropriate AI provider and handling subscription credit deduction, file export, and notification responses.

App.name: WalletPay - PayMoney Multi Wallet Mobile App
App.description: WalletPay is a secure multi-wallet mobile app built with React Native, designed as the Android companion to the PayMoney payment gateway platform. It allows users to send, receive, exchange, deposit, and withdraw money across multiple currencies and wallets, all through a fast and intuitive interface. The app supports QR-based payments, crypto send and receive via Tatum.io, biometric authentication, KYC verification, and multiple deposit gateways including Stripe, PayPal, and Flutterwave.
features: Send and receive money instantly using email or phone number
Multi-currency wallet management with real-time exchange rates
QR-Pay for sending, requesting, and merchant payments
Crypto send and receive via Tatum.io including token support
Deposit via Stripe, PayPal, Bank, Flutterwave, and CoinPayments
Biometric authentication for secure and fast login
Manual KYC verification for identity validation
Light and dark theme with RTL language support
Transaction history with step-by-step transaction details
Auto online/offline detection with role and permission management

lessons.text: Regular React Native version upgrades are essential to maintain performance and compatibility with the latest Android versions.
QR-based payment flows need thorough testing across devices to ensure scan accuracy and transaction reliability.
Crypto integration requires careful handling of wallet addresses, token types, and provider response differences.
RTL support and biometric authentication are best planned early, as retrofitting them into an existing flow causes widespread changes.

challenges.problem: Transaction list and bottom sheet opening times were slow, degrading the experience for users with large transaction histories.
challenges.solution: Reduced loading time for transaction history and bottom sheet rendering through optimized list handling and response time improvements.

challenges.problem: Request money, accept money, and cancel request flows had recurring bugs across platform updates.
challenges.solution: Refactored the send and request money logic and fixed edge cases for accept, decline, and cancel flows with proper API handling.

challenges.problem: Adding crypto token send and receive via Tatum.io required new wallet architecture not present in the original app.
challenges.solution: Extended the existing crypto module to support Tatum.io token transactions with dedicated wallet balance and address management.

roleCards.title: UI Development
roleCards.body: Built and maintained mobile screens for wallet dashboard, send/request money, QR-pay, crypto transactions, KYC verification, and transaction history, including light/dark theme and RTL layout support.

roleCards.title: Integration
roleCards.body: Integrated multiple deposit gateways (Stripe, PayPal, Flutterwave, CoinPayments), Tatum.io crypto send/receive, biometric login, and the PayMoney REST API for all wallet and transaction operations.

roleCards.title: Performance
roleCards.body: Optimized transaction list loading, bottom sheet performance, and WebView rendering times, and improved overall app stability through regular React Native and dependency upgrades.

archCards.title: Frontend Layer
archCards.body: Built with React Native for Android, organized into feature modules for wallets, transactions, crypto, QR payments, and user management, with light and dark theme support and RTL-ready responsive layouts.

archCards.title: State Management
archCards.body: Managed multi-wallet balances, active currency selection, transaction states, and session data to keep all financial views synchronized after every send, receive, exchange, or deposit action.

archCards.title: Backend Integration
archCards.body: Connected to the PayMoney REST API with secure token-based authentication, integrating multiple payment gateways, Tatum.io for crypto operations, and real-time email and SMS notification handling for all transaction types.

Others.name: Covid-19 Info
Others.description: A simple practice project built to display real-time Covid-19 statistics worldwide and for Bangladesh, using a public API. It shows total cases, deaths, and recovered counts by country in a clean table layout.

Country-wise breakdown of total cases, deaths, recovered, and new cases
Data fetched from a public Covid-19 REST API

Others.name: Brikkhorongon
Others.description: A practice project built as a tree plantation and environmental awareness website for Bangladesh. Developed to practice React fundamentals, including Components, Props, State Management, Event Handling, Conditional Rendering, Lists & Keys, React Hooks (useState, useEffect), React Router, Form Handling, API Integration, and Responsive UI Design, while presenting Bengali content in a clean and user-friendly interface.

Tree plantation information and initiative details

challenges.problem: Presenting Bengali content consistently across different browsers while maintaining readability.
challenges.solution: Used web-safe fonts, optimized font rendering, and performed cross-browser testing to ensure consistent Bengali text display and readability.

Others.name: Tic Toc Toi

Simple and clean game interface

Managing turn-based flow improved understanding of event-driven programming with React Js..

Others.name: Todo - React Hooks

Clean and minimal UI built with React

Others.name: PharmaLogy

Others.name: Medical
